name: commander
description: CC Commander — Guided AI PM for Claude Code. Brain/hands architecture with **22 specialist sub-agent personas** (architect · reviewer · builder · security-auditor · debugger · designer · qa-engineer · devops · data-analyst · content-strategist · product-manager · performance-engineer · researcher · technical-writer · fleet-worker · typescript-reviewer · python-reviewer). **62 plugin skills** incl **17 click-first `/ccc-*` workflows** + `/save-session` + `/resume-session` + `/ccc-fleet-viz` + `/ccc-changelog` + `/ccc-doctor` + `/ccc-upgrade` + `/ccc-deploy` + `/ccc-rollback` + `/ccc-onboard`. **9 lifecycle hooks × 24 handlers** (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, Notification, PreCompact, SubagentStop). **2 credential-free bundled MCP servers** (context7 + sequential-thinking) + 16 opt-in via /ccc-connect. Native Plan pane integration (EnterPlanMode + ExitPlanMode), spawn_task sidebar chips, mark_chapter session nav. 502+ skills across 11 CCC domains. Works in Claude Code Desktop, Cowork Desktop, CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Continue, Codex. **MIT-licensed plugin core, free for individuals. Pro tier with unlimited hosted MCP, premium skill packs, priority support — $19/mo · $190/yr · $299 lifetime (limited launch).**

interface.shortDescription: Guided AI PM. 51 skills, 17 specialist agents, 8 hooks. Free for now.
interface.longDescription: CC Commander is a PM/orchestration layer over Codex's sub-agent primitive. Brain/hands architecture: opinionated workflows for plan→build→review→ship. Works equally well in Claude Code and Codex CLI.
